name: gf2m_mult_m163_908and
detail: degree <= 2 (circuit and reference); all 119806 inputs of weight <= 2 agree with every AND / erasure precondition (74007 ops) => all inputs, all measurement outcomes
reference_how: generated from the definition (schoolbook a_i b_j x^(i+j) reduced mod the NIST polynomial x^163+x^7+x^6+x^3+1), independent of the circuit; checked on 300 random inputs against polynomial multiplication + long division
wires: a = q[0..162], b = q[163..325], c = q[326..488] (bit i = coefficient of x^i), q[489] clean ancilla
note: c ^= a*b in GF(2^163) (NIST B-163/K-163 field), CRT bilinear algorithm of rank 908 (qoptct.crypto.gf2m_multiply(163), seed 0).  Proved by qoptct.verify.exact2 (all wires of GF(2) degree <= 2: the 119806 inputs of weight <= 2 decide all inputs; all measurement outcomes); the BDD engine of kprove runs out of memory here (2 GB machine).  Not a record of bilinear complexity: 906 in arXiv:1303.7082.
